headline: A fragile rotation, not a broad recovery
summary: Friday's semiconductor stabilisation did not repair Thursday's sell-off. Broader equity weakness, rising oil and higher yields leave the near-term outlook vulnerable.

highlights.title: Participation remains weak
highlights.text: Equal-weight equities lagged the S&P 500. Semiconductor gains were selective rather than a broad recovery.

highlights.title: AI financing quality matters
highlights.text: Strong AI demand does not guarantee strong cash returns. The report distinguishes cash-generative platforms from businesses dependent on external funding.

highlights.title: Oil, yields and the Fed
highlights.text: Higher energy prices and yields pressure financing conditions. The 27–28 October Fed meeting falls inside the forecast window.

forecast.horizon: 26–28 October US sessions · S&P 500 final close
forecast.method: Subjective research probabilities, not statistically calibrated. Boundaries define final-close outcomes, not technical support or resistance.
forecast.watch_next: Improving equal-weight participation and Nvidia leadership with contained yields would favour Bull/Base in the next forecast. Confirmed credit stress, renewed AI financing pressure and higher oil would favour Bear.

limitations: VIX close, put/call and credit-spread confirmation were unavailable. Research outlook only; not a trading signal or guarantee.
